summary: Meridian Corp filed an 8-K on July 30, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results via press release and earnings supplement, and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per share payable August 17, 2026. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is routine earnings and dividend disclosure, limited to Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01. There are no deal terms, premiums, advisors, or strategic actions. This is an ordinary current report, not a special situation.
